**Out-of-sample prediction:** mean = 0.42, sd = 0.18

I shaded the prediction down substantially from the in-sample value of 0.66 because:
- ~120 evaluate() calls were used in the search, introducing selection/multiple-comparisons bias that inflates in-sample Sharpe relative to true out-of-sample performance
- 3-feature combinations with hand-tuned signs are especially prone to overfitting on n=5000 samples
- The wide standard deviation (0.18) reflects genuine uncertainty about how much of this edge is real signal vs. in-sample noise fitting
